name: ims_trojan_horse_backend
description: IoT Alarm Flow Management Backend for TESCO

scripts.build: npm run build:lib && npm run build:functions && npm run copy:lib
scripts.copy:lib: cp -r lib/dist functions/fn-alarm-management/dist/lib && cp -r lib/dist functions/fn-analysis-engine/dist/lib && cp -r lib/dist functions/fn-chat-api/dist/lib && cp -r lib/dist functions/fn-csv-handler/dist/lib && cp -r lib/dist functions/fn-job-worker/dist/lib
scripts.build:functions: npm run build:fn-alarm-management && npm run build:fn-chat-api && npm run build:fn-csv-handler && npm run build:fn-analysis-engine && npm run build:fn-job-worker
scripts.install:functions: cd functions/fn-alarm-management && npm install && cd ../fn-chat-api && npm install && cd ../fn-csv-handler && npm install && cd ../fn-analysis-engine && npm install && cd ../fn-job-worker && npm install
